errors.text_span: 最左侧的“症状”柱体显著高于其余所有柱体，视觉上最为突出
errors.evidence: The description uses subjective and evaluative language such as '显著高于' (significantly higher) and '视觉上最为突出' (visually the most prominent). The prompt requires an objective description using neutral language.
The y-axis does not have any units labeled. While '个' (items/count) is the implied unit for '数量' (quantity), it is not explicitly stated on the chart, and thus should not be reported as if it were.
